interface-id.description: Source identifier of this interface, scoped to its host or provider.

ip-address.description: Address associated with the interface; the attribute type does not imply traffic direction. Use a separate observation for each address/prefix pair.

name.description: Interface name, such as eth0 or a provider-assigned interface label.

namespace.description: Namespace that distinguishes this interface from similarly named interfaces.

subnet-prefix.description: Prefix length associated with ip-address, using the correct IPv4 or IPv6 width.

type.description: Interface kind such as Wired, Wireless, Mobile, or Tunnel.

description: A physical or virtual network interface with its own identity, namespace and addressing, separate from the host and connections using it. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/network_interface.
name: network-interface
